verdict.rationale: GrowthBook ships officially documented SDKs across backend, web (React, script tag), and mobile (Kotlin/Android, Swift/iOS), with GitHub README citing 24 SDKs total, and community reports confirm quick multi-stack integration (Vue frontend in hours). The architecture is explicitly designed for consistent behavior: a single cacheable JSON feature definition is evaluated identically across SDKs via local evaluation, per community/docs evidence.  Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration specifically for mobile SDK parity/consistency (only docs-level evidence), and the one community remark noting mobile SDKs were absent is outdated (2021) but not directly refuted by newer evidence beyond docs.
